review.tagline: Gradio web UI for local text, image, audio, video and 3D generation
review.summary: biniou is a self-hosted Gradio web UI that bundles many generative modules: a llama-cpp chatbot for GGUF models, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion and Flux image generation, MusicGen audio, video and Shap-E 3D. It runs on CPU from 8GB RAM, with optional CUDA or experimental ROCm, and can work offline once models are downloaded. Installers exist for several Linux distributions and Windows, plus a Dockerfile.
review.audience: Self-hosters wanting one local multimodal generative AI UI, even without a GPU
strengths: Covers text, image, audio, video and 3D generation in one UI
Runs on CPU only, from 8GB RAM; CUDA and experimental ROCm optional
One-click installers for several Linux distros and Windows; Dockerfile provided
Modules can pass outputs to each other; generation settings saved as metadata
weaknesses: AMD64 only; macOS support is experimental and untested
Many modules need 16GB+ RAM; about 200GB of disk with default models
Python 3.10 or 3.11 required; Windows install adds Visual Studio Build tools
Chatbot has no stated agents, tools or document chat; the README lists only chat and multimodal
needs: Needs Python 3.10/3.11, git, ffmpeg, openssl, Hugging Face model downloads
Models: GGUF (llama-cpp), Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1/XL/3.5, Flux, LoRA, safetensors
